title: KeyManagerCertificate

pem.description: The certificate as PEM: what add or update pins as the connection's CA once a person accepts it.

sha256Fingerprint.description: Its SHA-256 fingerprint: 32 bytes in upper-case hex, joined by colons.

subject.description: Its subject, one line (CN=agent-harness test CA).

names.description: The DNS names and IP addresses its subject alternative names hold, in its order; empty for none.

selfSigned.description: Whether it signs itself: a root, rather than an intermediate or a leaf a CA issued.

description: The certificate a key manager's chain is anchored on, read from its TLS handshake with verification off: the issuer walked up to, else the leaf, as PEM, with its SHA-256 fingerprint, subject, names, expiry and whether it signs itself.
